topic: Buying used vs new — depreciation drill (Kit vs Aspen)

scenes.narration: New cars lose thirty percent driving off the lot. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym pointing at a giant comic burst banner reading THIRTY PERCENT GONE, a model car beside him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Kit and Aspen both have eight thousand dollars saved for a car.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man kit and woman aspen each holding envelopes stamped EIGHT THOUSAND DOWN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each needs a reliable car for forty mile daily commutes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a long highway with a FORTY MILE marker, both kit and aspen needing transportation, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Kit puts eight thousand down on a new thirty thousand SUV.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, kit at a dealership signing papers under a new SUV with a price tag THIRTY THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He finances the rest at seven percent over six years.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, kit holding a loan paper stamped TWENTY TWO THOUSAND AT SEVEN PERCENT SIX YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Aspen buys a four year old sedan for nine thousand cash.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, aspen handing cash to a private seller in a driveway beside a clean reliable sedan, price tag NINE THOUSAND CASH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She trades in her old car for an extra one thousand.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, aspen handing over her old car keys and receiving an envelope stamped ONE THOUSAND TRADE IN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Three years later Kit's SUV is worth fourteen thousand dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, kit's SUV with a valuation sticker reading FOURTEEN THOUSAND, calendar showing three years passed, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He still owes seventeen thousand and is upside down on the loan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked kit at a kitchen table with a loan statement reading SEVENTEEN THOUSAND OWED, comic banner reads UPSIDE DOWN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Aspen's used sedan is worth six thousand and she owes nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, aspen's used sedan with a valuation sticker reading SIX THOUSAND, a paper stamped LOAN PAID OFF beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She invested eighteen thousand in skipped car payments instead.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, aspen smiling at a brokerage app reading EIGHTEEN THOUSAND INVESTED in big green numbers, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Buy reliable used cars in cash. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle, holding a clipboard reading USED RELIABLE SEDAN, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
